text:
morgan: FYI preflight gate failed for APAC canary - prompt-eval B shows answer accuracy collapse on short Q&A prompts. Need triage before the 04:00 PT change window.
deploybot: [automated] Preflight report: https://redwood.internal/evals/3187654321 — metric: answer_accuracy down 4.2% vs baseline on eval-B. Gate: quality-fail. Suggested actions: abort-canary, route-pin, request-exception.
eli: Is the failure localized to apac-west canary or seen in other routes? Any model variant mismatch?
trina: Quick diff: the canary is running model v2.0.0-qat; global is still v1.9.7. Yesterday's promotion introduced the v2.0 variant to APAC only.
morgan: So our choices: 1) abort-canary (stop promotion), 2) rollback apac route to v1.9.7, 3) product signs an eval-exception to continue. Which do we want?
devops-bot: Options and timings:
- abort-canary --canary apac-west (instant stop, no drain)
- rollback-route --route apac-west --to v1.9.7 (drain ~3m + warmup ~6m)
- pin-model global --version v1.9.7 (full drain ~15m)
- hotfix (requires build+test ~3-4h)
Note: rollback will cause KV cache misses and cold-start spikes for batched workers in APAC.
eli: I'm leaning rollback-route. Abort-canary is quick but leaves the canary image floating; rollback gives known stable behavior.
trina: Product: @product-zoe we need signoff for user-facing note if we rollback. Should be short and factual.
product-zoe: Abort canary for now. I'll prepare a release note: "APAC canary halted due to regression on short Q&A prompts; rolling back to v1.9.7 for stability. Investigation and bisect underway." Will post to #release-updates after action.
ben: SRE note 12 -- when rolling back, please throttle traffic (0% -> 25% -> 100%) to avoid autoscaler thrash. Watch error-rate and p50/p95 latency, and KV cache miss ratio.
morgan: @deploybot please create ticket and list bisect instructions and failing prompt IDs attached. Also include recommended throttle plan.
deploybot: [action] Created ticket RE-5902: "APAC canary halt & rollback to v1.9.7" 12 includes eval links, failing prompt IDs, and throttle steps.
eli: ACK. I'll run a focused bisect on token lengths 200-800 and post initial failing sample IDs in the ticket.
trina: After rollback and bisect, let's meet for a quick postmortem 1h after change window to decide on quant-profile vs training-change hypotheses.
morgan: Timeline: rollback trigger at 03:40 PT, product note posted by 03:45 PT, bisect results by 05:00 PT. Escalate to oncall if error rate >1% or latency >800ms.
product-zoe: ACK :thumbsup: Will publish note and ping PM stakeholders.
morgan: Thanks everyone. We'll continue updates in this thread.
